2) He asked me if he should invest in dogecoin because he heard Elon was pushing it.

And, that moment, I was choked.

The convergence of Internet culture, the rise of retail investing and the fact when people are at home have led to this speculative mania on stocks and crypto.

Analysis of 2021's Google Trends revealed that a significant amount of Canadians were searching how to escape their current financial situation...even investing in Dogecoin.
